abstract: Every day my inbox is filled with industry newsletters and press releases talking about the next wave of streaming media delivery. There are traditional broadcasters who have added a streaming service to their offering, dedicated “Over the Top” content distributors, and traditional cable and satellite providers, to mention just a few. Streaming delivery of media direct to the viewer at home on large screen TVs and computer screens, as well as on mobile devices of all types has become commonplace in our media-hungry world.
